crossRefs.note: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

translations.web: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
translations.bsb: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
translations.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
translations.asv: But Mary was standing without at the tomb weeping: so, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb;
